### 2. tool-update-owned-process-shutdown

|---|---|
| Route | `direct` |
| Diagnosis | `justfile:106-108` runs `dotnet tool update -g Darylmcd.RoslynMcp \|\| dotnet tool install -g …` with no lock handling.
